residualCases.publicQuestion: Show the ids of high schoolers who have friends and are also liked by someone else.
responses:
SELECT DISTINCT h.ID
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN Friend f ON h.ID = f.student_id
JOIN Likes l ON h.ID = l.liked_id;
